harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Hardened node1 OpenSSH and firewalld successfully. Only ssh-access members can authenticate with public keys; opsadmin has source-pinned, restricted key access from node2. Root, contractor, password authentication, interactive PTY use, and node3 network access are denied. All prepared data persisted through serial restarts of all three nodes.
actions_performed: Installed and validated an early-loading OpenSSH hardening configuration on node1.
Pinned the existing opsadmin key to node2's source address with restricted, non-interactive access.
Created the permanent ssh-admin firewalld zone for node2 and removed SSH from the public zone.
Verified authorized access and all required authentication/network denials.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Only ssh-access members may use public-key SSH; root, contractor, passwords, and interactive access are denied
evidence.summary: Effective configuration requires publickey, allows ssh-access, denies contractor/root and other authentication methods; final functional tests confirm all denials.

evidence.requirement: Pinned, non-interactive opsadmin key access from sshprobe on node2
evidence.summary: The original key fingerprint is retained with from="10.100.242.11",restrict; strict host-pinned BatchMode access succeeds and PTY allocation fails.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated ssh-admin jump-box boundary and node3 network denial
evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent ssh-admin allow SSH only from node2's /32 source; public exposes no SSH, and node3 receives a network-layer rejection.

evidence.requirement: Prepared accounts, keys, and data preserved
evidence.summary: Account identities, permissions, key fingerprints, known-host pins, and prepared-file digests remain intact after hardening and restarts.
Captured healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered services/configuration/data, authorized node2 access, and continued node3 denial.
Captured baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, preserved sshprobe credentials and pins, recovered services/IP, and successful jump-box access.
Captured baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered services/network, and continued rejection from node1 SSH.
